feature: Backend connects to all mock servers at startup
steps: Open the mock server console at http://localhost:3031
Read the columns 'Status' and 'Connected clients' of 'Bahn 1', 'Bahn 2' and 'Weichen'
expected: 'Bahn 1', 'Bahn 2' and 'Weichen' are all 'Online' and each has at least 1 connected client

feature: Page structure follows the UI specification
steps: Open the app
Read the page structure
expected: The page has a header with the title 'Gartenbahn', a card 'Gartenbahn-Ansicht' with a track graphic, a card 'Control Panel' with a train selection that offers exactly the two trains 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2', a stop list, a Start button and a status badge, a button 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' and a card 'Betriebsprotokoll'; there is no login or account form

feature: Track graphic in the preview
steps: Open the app
Take a screenshot of the track graphic in the card 'Gartenbahn-Ansicht'
expected: The preview shows an oval main loop, a siding below the bottom straight between two switches, a third switch on the siding from which a dead-end spur leads to the right and ends at a buffer stop labelled 'Kalibrierpunkt', and the four labelled stops 'Haltestelle 1' (top straight), 'Haltestelle 2' (right curve), 'Haltestelle 3' (bottom straight) and 'Haltestelle 4' (left curve)

feature: First setup asks for the first train and shows the switch hint
steps: Open the app
Read the page without clicking anything
expected: A dialog asks the user to place the first train ('Bahn 1') on the calibration point and offers a button to confirm this, and the page shows a hint that the user should check whether the switches are set correctly

feature: Controls are locked until the first setup is completed
steps: Open the app
Without confirming anything in the calibration dialog, try to click the Start button
Try to click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen'
Read the status badge and the stop list
expected: The Start button is disabled or cannot be reached, no stop can be added, and the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt'

feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
steps: Open the app
In the calibration dialog, click the button that confirms that the first train is on the calibration point
Wait 25 seconds, then take a new accessibility snapshot
Read the calibration dialog
expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point

feature: A second frontend shows the current setup step
steps: Open the app
Open the app URL in a second browser tab
Read the calibration dialog in the second tab
expected: The second tab directly shows the current step, i.e. the request to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point, not the request for the first train

feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
steps: Open the app
Open the app URL in a second browser tab
In the second tab, click the button that confirms that the second train is on the calibration point
Wait 25 seconds, then take a new accessibility snapshot
Read the page in the second tab
Switch to the first tab without reloading it
Read the page in the first tab
Take a screenshot of the track graphic in the first tab
expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled, and the track graphic shows markers for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'

feature: Each train is calibrated in its own direction
steps: Open the mock server console at http://localhost:3031
Read the column 'Applied speed changes (oldest first)' of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
expected: The history of 'Bahn 1' contains a low speed greater than 0 with the direction backward (the calibration speed: 'Bahn 1' backs against the buffer stop), the history of 'Bahn 2' contains the same low speed with the direction forward, and for both trains it is later followed by speed 0

feature: After the setup the first train waits at the calibration waiting point and the second stays at the calibration point
steps: Open the mock server console at http://localhost:3031
Read the columns 'Applied speed changes (oldest first)' and 'Speed (0-255)' of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
expected: After its calibration speed, the history of 'Bahn 1' contains a higher speed with the direction forward (the drive to the calibration waiting point) and then speed 0; the history of 'Bahn 2' contains only the calibration speed and speed 0 (no higher speed); the current speed of both trains is 0
